nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 linear regulator converts external VIN_5V to the internal VCC_3V3 rail for the full logic and CAN interface domain. This module is the sole provider of VCC_3V3 and distributes that rail to the MCU, standalone CAN controller, and CAN transceiver. Input uses VIN_5V directly and output powers all downstream 3.3V consumers; regulator stability and bypass support are implemented later. No separate enable or mode control pins are provided in the supplied pin data, so the intent is always-on operation whenever VIN_5V is present.
5V to 3.3V LDO

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: STM32F103 MCU is the system host controller. It powers from VCC_3V3, acts as SPI master toward the MCP2515 CAN controller, provides a dedicated chip-select, receives interrupt status from the CAN controller, and can optionally drive the CAN controller reset line if firmware-controlled reset is desired. The MCU exchanges CAN frames only through the MCP2515 and does not connect directly to the physical CAN bus. Because no STM32F103 pin data is provided, pin-level boot, clock, and debug wiring must be resolved downstream without assuming specific pins here; this module only declares the required logical interfaces and 3.3V supply dependency.
ARM Cortex-M3 MCU

nodes.name: can_controller
nodes.description: MCP2515 standalone CAN controller bridges the MCU SPI domain to the CAN transceiver logic domain. It powers from VCC_3V3, accepts SPI_MOSI, SPI_SCK, chip-select, and reset control from the MCU, returns SPI_MISO to the MCU, and asserts INT back to the MCU for receive and status events. On the CAN-side interface, TXCAN drives the transceiver D input and RXCAN receives from the transceiver R output. The supplied pin data includes OSC1 and OSC2, so this module requires an external oscillator or crystal network added downstream to establish MCP2515 timing. CLKOUT, TX0RTS, TX1RTS, TX2RTS, RX0BF, and RX1BF are available on the device but are not required by the brief and may remain unused unless later firmware requirements need them.
SPI CAN controller

nodes.name: can_transceiver
nodes.description: SN65HVD230 is the 3.3V CAN physical-layer transceiver. It powers from VCC_3V3, receives transmit data on D from the MCP2515 TXCAN path, and returns receive data on R to the MCP2515 RXCAN path. CANH and CANL expose the differential bus interface for the external CAN network. VREF is a device output reference and is not required by the brief unless later used for monitoring or biasing. RS sets transceiver operating slope or standby behavior through an external bias network added downstream; because the brief does not specify standby control and no dedicated controller signal is provided in the component list, this module should be planned for normal active bus operation using passive configuration. Any bus termination or split termination remains a downstream passive network and is not owned by another active module.
3.3V CAN transceiver
